title: 第24章 谷川：我太内疚了
content_zh:
谷川人在美国，但却非常繁忙，一直接听来自国内的电话。

    陆穿被抓的第一天，曹郁和小刘小胖这些人给他打电话。

    陆穿被抓的第二天，一些国内影视圈的人，不知道怎么得到了他的电话，迂回着询问他什么时候回国。

    陆穿被抓的第三天，一些不知道是什么部门的人，问了谷川一些情况，也问了他还回不回国。

    陆穿被抓的第四天，谷川手机关机了。

    国内的纸媒和互联网，都在谈论陆穿被抓的事情。

    他这一抓，意义非凡。

    很多想了解情况的人，想办法进入互联网，查看消息，极大地促进了互联网的发展。

    而且纸媒这几天，只要在标题上挂上陆穿的名字，销量立马飙升。

    陆穿功德无量啊。

    “谷川，你回国吧，陆穿快被放出来了。”

    “消息可靠吗？”

    “可靠。”

    “那小王总呢？”

    “他还没有。”

    陆穿被抓的第五天，曹郁打电话，谷川也准备回国。

    既然陆穿都出来了，那他就更没有事情了。

    说好了下周回国，那下周肯定就要回国。

    谷川是一个言而有信的人，和贾某人可不一样。

    “沃伦，我走了。”

    “你终于走了。”

    看到沃伦那副送瘟神的模样，谷川不满地皱眉。

    算了，没必要和他计较，反正我还会回来的。

    不过下次回来不能住他家了，那时候自己应该已经混出来了，或者是开始躲着警察了。

    谷川订了最近的机票，随行的还有华谊那个刚来美国就失联的经理。

    “我还以为你捐款跑路了呢。”谷川看着那人说道。

    “没有，我太倒霉了。”

    那经理表情很差。

    他刚下飞机没多久，身上的包包证件就被偷走了，然后就被警察当成偷渡的抓了起来。

    就在今天，警察才抓住小偷，找到了证件把他放出来。

    来到美国这么久，终于可以联系谷川了，可刚联系上，就被通知要回国了。
content_en:
Tanigawa is from the United States, but he is very busy and has been answering calls from China.

    On the first day Lu Chuan was arrested, people like Cao Yu and Xiao Liu Xiaopang called him.

    The day after Lu Chuan was arrested, some people in the domestic film and television industry somehow got his phone number and asked him in a roundabout way when he would return to China.

    On the third day after Lu Chuan was arrested, some people from unknown departments asked Tanichuan some information and asked him whether he would return to his country.

    On the fourth day after Lu Chuan was arrested, Tanichuan's cell phone was turned off.

    Domestic print media and the Internet are all talking about Lu Chuan's arrest.

    His catch was of great significance.

    Many people who want to know the situation find ways to access the Internet and check the news, which greatly promotes the development of the Internet.

    Moreover, in the past few days, as long as Lu Chuan's name is listed in the title of the print media, sales will immediately soar.

    Lu Chuan’s merits are immeasurable.

    "Tani Chuan, you should go back to China, Lu Chuan will be released soon."

    "Is the news reliable?"

    "Reliable."

    "What about Mr. Xiao Wang?"

    "He hasn't yet."

    On the fifth day after Lu Chuan was arrested, Cao Yu called and Gu Chuan was also preparing to return home.

    Now that Lu Chuan has come out, he has nothing to worry about.

    We agreed to return to China next week, so we will definitely return to China next week.

    Tanichuan is a person who keeps his word, which is different from Jia.

    "Warren, I'm leaving."

    "You're finally gone."

    Seeing Warren's look of sending off the plague, Tanichuan frowned dissatisfied.

    Forget it, there is no need to argue with him, I will come back anyway.

    But I can't stay at his house next time I come back. By then, I should have mixed up, or started hiding from the police.

    Tanichuan booked the nearest flight ticket, accompanied by Huayi's manager who had lost contact when he first came to the United States.

    "I thought you donated money and ran away." Tanichuan looked at the man and said.

    "No, I'm so unlucky."

    The manager looked very bad.

    Not long after he got off the plane, his bag and ID were stolen, and he was arrested by the police as a stowaway.

    Just today, the police caught the thief and found the documents and released him.

    After coming to the United States for so long, I was finally able to contact Tanigawa, but as soon as I did, I was informed that I had to return to my country.
title_en: Chapter 24 Tanichuan: I feel so guilty
